claim.quote: A significant excess of pairs is observed above the yield expected from neutral meson decays.

name: NA60 first measurement of the rho spectral function in high-energy nuclear collisions

summary.plain: NA60 measured muon pairs from indium-indium collisions with unprecedented precision, finding an excess dominated by pion annihilation through the rho meson. The rho's spectral function is strongly broadened but essentially not shifted in mass.
summary.technical: Precision measurement of low-mass muon pairs in 158 AGeV In-In: an excess above neutral-meson decays isolated in a 360000-dimuon sample with about 2% mass resolution, consistent with pi+pi- -> rho -> mu+mu-; the space-time averaged rho spectral function shows strong broadening with essentially no mass shift.

title: First Measurement of the rho Spectral Function in High-Energy Nuclear Collisions
why_it_matters: Distinguishes in-medium broadening from dropping-mass scenarios of chiral symmetry restoration, a key test for thermal dilepton radiation.
